payload.author: framework-coordinator
evidence: Following the reviewed packed-raster integration and fresh destination checks, authorize a new isolated checkout for both keyed bodies, their declarations, focused actual-source tests and same-commit debt-ceiling reductions. Preserve original task baseline, all historical claims and outstanding discoveries. No framework change, flag change or new protected-match regression is authorized.

Use evidence-backed provisional draw_color_key overloads with count and Vert* UV, documenting their behavioral basis. Preserve canonical original names/spans and publish only explicit emitted-symbol fact changes through match_recovery.source.writer.write_symbol using current reader snapshots and fresh compiler evidence. Do not collide with the different opaque packed draw_trans signature or hand-edit ORIGINAL markers.

Reuse typed plain-edge and PC24/chop helpers where actually common; no hardcoded original-address state, assembly, copied bytes, fixed four/eight count truncation, or texture/UV array type punning. Correct both bodies from original evidence rather than retaining the current bad non-sentinel implementation merely to limit diff size.

Require actual-source controls for arbitrary counts, explicit UVs, key holes, width-based sampling, clipped/final rows, absolute even/odd and negative Y parity, low-byte alternate colors, and -1 versus other negative colors. Investigate zero/inverted clipped-span countdown and speculative final-source reads explicitly; preserve unresolved exceptional geometry, shared-scratch and callback-visible FP-status findings without claiming full equivalence.

Fresh protected-byte checks, scoped reference/layout checks, claim continuity, source controls, application compile/link and coordinator original/source review precede manual integration; repeat checks on the destination. Only the native recorder can bank any actual matching discovery. This authorization is not a working-game or automatic-acceptance claim.
